originality.rationale: An exact odd-characteristic threefold convolution and all-prime-power diameter classification with a genuine elliptic character-sum phase and q=5,7,9 exceptions is not a restatement of the inspected Kloosterman eigenvalue bounds or of the anisotropic torus theorem. The same hyperbola set appears in Forey et al.; its eigenvalues in principle determine the convolution by inverse Fourier transform, but the inspected statements do not evaluate that inversion, elliptic family, or the exceptional support. Originality is bounded, not priority certification.

value.rationale: Determining the exact Cayley diameter over every odd finite field is a canonical completeness invariant for a Kloosterman inverse-graph walk. The q=5,7,9 diameter-four exceptions, distinct q=11 exact-length hole, and genus-one point-count mechanism are motivated structural boundaries. They explain when three inverse graph increments provide universal reachability, and quantify the entire third convolution; these go beyond a small arbitrary slice or a formal spectral re-expression.
